item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya connects a nichrome wire to a cell in her school laboratory. After a few minutes, she notices that the wire has become warm.

Which statement correctly explains why the wire becomes warm?

options.A: The wire becomes warm simply because the cell is connected; current plays no part in heating.
options.B: The wire becomes warm first, and its warmth then makes the electric current flow through it.
options.C: Only nichrome wires become warm when an electric current flows; copper wires never do.
options.D: The current flowing through the wire meets resistance, and this resistance produces heat in the wire.
